book-session.title: Book a Session — UniSkilled
book-session.choose-a-time-and: Choose a time and your price. The tutor accepts or declines — you only pay after they accept.
book-session.subject: Subject *
book-session.your-offer-for-this: Your offer for this session Listed rate:
book-session.preparing-for-an-exam: Preparing for an exam? Add the date so your tutor can plan the lessons around it.
book-session.you-wont-be-charged: You won't be charged yet. This sends a request to the tutor. If they accept, you'll have up to 24 hours to pay and lock in the session (or until 1 hour before it starts, if that's sooner).
book-session.by-requesting-a-session: By requesting a session you agree to our Terms of Service and Refund Policy.
book-session.payment-protected-once-you: Payment protected. Once you pay, your money is held for 48 hours after the session — full refund if something goes wrong.
book-session.never-lose-money-to: Never lose money to a no-show. If your tutor cancels, you're refunded automatically. If they don't show up, report it from your dashboard within 48 hours for a full refund.
book-session.what-do-you-want.placeholde: What do you want to cover? Any specific topics or questions?
book-session.js.price-hint: Minimum {{min}}. Agreed on a different price in chat? Enter it here — the tutor will see your offer and can accept or decline.
book-session.js.no-rate-alert: {{name}} hasn't set an hourly rate yet, so this session can't be booked. Send them a message to ask when they'll be available.
book-session.js.blocked-day: This tutor is fully unavailable on this date. Please pick a different day.
book-session.js.blocked-time: This tutor is unavailable between {{from}}–{{to}} on this date. Please pick a different time.
book-session.js.exam-date: Please check the exam date. It can be today or any date in the next year.
book-session.js.too-soon: Please choose a time at least 2 hours from now.
book-session.js.blocked: This tutor is not available at the selected date/time. Please choose a different slot.
book-session.js.send-failed: Could not send your request. Please try again.
book-session.js.sent: ✅ Request sent! We'll notify you the moment {{name}} responds. If they accept, you'll have up to 24 hours to pay and lock in the session (or until 1 hour before it starts, if that's sooner).
